description:
S01 E07 — A Witness to Murder
Detective Arthur Hill is on the case to catch a suspected killer, but he's relying on a witness who is fearful because they survived a gunshot from the suspect; Detective Stewart is called to a busy intersection.

title: Homicide Squad New Orleans
description:
S01 E06 — Afternoon Ambush
With the help of Det Johnson and Det Stewart, Det Diesburg pieces together what happened one Saturday afternoon when two teens fired rifles on two other teens driving down the street in a residential neighborhood in the 6th district.

title: Homicide Squad New Orleans
description:
S02 E06 — Friends & Enemies
Lead detective Nick Davis investigates a local artist found murdered in his home; with very little evidence, detective Davis methodically pursues every lead until a lucky break points him toward a surprise suspect.

title: Homicide Squad New Orleans
description:
S01 E03 — Mardi Gras Murder
During Mardi Gras festivities in New Orleans, Mervin Magee is shot multiple times in the French Quarter; Detective James Fyfe faces an uphill battle to collect footage that shows the identity of the perpetrator before it expires.

title: Homicide Squad New Orleans
description:
S01 E05 — A Mother's Betrayal
In Gentilly, Detective Rayell Johnson investigates the murder of Travis Hobbs, 42, a New Orleans native; Hobbs gets shot in his truck during a thunderstorm.

title: Homicide Squad New Orleans
description:
S01 E10 — The Rookie
Aided by the know-how of veteran officers in the department and his own investigative skills, Rookie Detective Donnie Willyard tracks down a suspect who allegedly shot a man in the front entrance of his home nearly 10 times.

title: Homicide Squad New Orleans
description:
S01 E04 — Know Thy Neighbor
Lead Detective Tanisha Sykes Smith works the case of Roderick Thompson, a lifetime resident of the Lower 9th Ward found murdered about a block away from his mother's home; Detective Smith works the case step-by-step to apprehend the alleged shooter.
